rationale: The price has failed to sustain momentum above the 9-EMA and is showing a series of lower highs and lower lows on the most recent 1m candles, indicating the mean reversion attempt is losing steam. With the broader market (SPY) down significantly and the VIX surging, the risk of a retest of the daily lows is high, making it prudent to lock in the current unrealized gain rather than risking a reversal into a loss.
